_about: FICTIONAL example workspaces for RAGaaS marketing pages and demos. Every company, person, document, number and quote here is invented; any resemblance to a real business is coincidental. Usage figures are example data and must be labelled as such wherever they are shown.

_schema.documents[]: file, title, pages, audience (who may read it), restricted (true = never searched for anyone outside audience), summary, questions (starter questions the document answers)
_schema.qa: the hero question: asked by persona, answered from doc/page, with the exact cited excerpt split into before/highlight/after; also_cites = second source
_schema.gaps[]: questions no document answers, with how many times they were asked this month
_schema.new_doc: the page the owner writes to close the top gap
_schema.academy: the onboarding path built for persona's role, with one quiz question
_schema.example_usage: illustrative month-3 numbers for the example workspace (not real data)
_schema.slug, plural: industry page route (/for/<slug>) and the plural used in its headline
